structural_change: NATIVE-FIX3 rr1 (2026-10-18): rs -> ot_hbm_rly RS_RELAY=1 = registered reset relay (rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv, 2 sync + 1 relay flop) so the W-face rs pin drives 3 flops instead of the async clear of all 136 stage flops (closed hbfd_rly_136_ns_fc-fc2-02fc2ee56: routed native capture rs 193.9 ps > 190, NATIVE-3). Data path, outline, pin plan (rs on W) unchanged; stage release 3 clock edges after rs (as the > 256 b classes), assert async/immediate; 0 data cycles. Was: F1 forwarded-clock variant of hbfd_rly_136_NS (owner neighbour-relative clocking; DIE-CLOCK form F1): same ot_hbm_rly stage on clk_in, clk_out + every o through one kept BUFx12f each, data face 32.4 um (<= 6 pins/um; was 21.6), outline 32.4 x 21.6. fc2: the clk_out buffer input is held off the clk_in net through CTS and reconnected to the root (fc1: TritonCTS made it a tree sink, clk_in->clk_out 58 ps through CTS buffers); forwarded-hop min separation 85 / 55 ps (fc1 50 ps padded the 624 inputs: native capture 193.5)

reroute_reason.fix: ot_hbm_rly RS_RELAY=1 in this master only (default 0 elsewhere): rs drives the 3-flop registered reset relay beside the W face, the relay drives the 136 stage clears; release +3 edges (bench REL 3 expected-o model, reset-relay-bypass mutant FAILs)
reroute_reason.why_route: NATIVE-3 audit (claude/native-3-1017 73adc87ea, lanes/NATIVE-3.md): hbfd_rly_136_NS_fc rs capture 193.9 ps > 190 (one pin, rs = async clear of all 136 stage flops) in CLOSED hbfd_rly_136_ns_fc-fc2-02fc2ee56; relative re-audit vs neighbour relays still FAIL (lanes/NATIVE-FIX3.md step 1). kind rtl_change: the master's RTL changes (RS_RELAY=1), so native_capture (same-RTL re-kit) does not apply.
